title: The outline generation screen
question: The roll dealt The Now Column. Lock it, or take The Galley Proof or The Drawing Board.

options.label: The Now Column
options.lineage: the notebook open beside its ruled log sheet on the same desk
options.thesis: The generation narrates itself from one sticky column while the Outline takes the rest of the width in two proof columns.
options.viewport: Left 22rem: the four steps as a spine with the live one marked, a ticking elapsed, one large now line, then the message log and Cancel. Right: Topic and Goal over two columns of Modules, the frontier Lesson writing in under skeleton rules; Sources close the page.
options.risk: The status column can steal the Outline's thunder, and sticky status panes are familiar chrome; the now line must stay a caption, not a second headline.

options.label: The Galley Proof
options.lineage: the galley a typesetter reads before the page is run
options.thesis: The Outline is a galley being set: a running head counts the Lessons in as the page fills column by column, one line visibly being set at the frontier.
options.viewport: A narrow run spine holds the four steps, elapsed and Cancel. The galley spans the rest: running head with the live count, Modules set in two paper columns, the frontier line shimmering under the next Lesson; Sources and Why this shape close as margin notes.
options.risk: A two-column galley tempts a newspaper pastiche; the columns must stay a reading order, not a costume, and long Lesson summaries can break the set.

options.label: The Drawing Board
options.lineage: the drafting board where the Course is laid out before a word is written
options.thesis: The Course is drafted in space: Modules stand as columns across the board, the writing front travels left to right, and Connections draws the lines between them.
options.viewport: A slim running head carries the four steps and the elapsed; beneath it the whole board: each Module a column, written ones solid, the current one filling in, later ones dashed at mark; Connections draws its strokes along the floor; Sources sit in a tray at the foot.
options.risk: At mastery depth the board can reach ten Modules and must pan with edge fades rather than shrink into ten unreadable slivers; connection strokes must not become decoration.
